title.narrative: ELRHA capacity building fund Niger and Somalia

description.narrative: Although interest in renewable energy is growing among humanitarian actors in Niger, there is limited technical expertise to properly design and manage solar energy systems suited to humanitarian needs. As a result, teams often depend on external contractors without the skills to evaluate system sizing, technology options, or long-term maintenance, leading to inefficiencies and sustainability challenges. The REact initiative addresses this gap by providing structured methods and practical training to build staff capacity. This support is timely, helping humanitarian teams transition to renewable energy, reduce fuel reliance, manage rising operational costs, and improve climate resilience through more systematic and technically sound energy planning.
